data.title: Remote surgery 'successful'
data.description: <p>Thailand has performed its first remote robotic surgery for prostate cancer, with a surgical team in Bangkok operating on a patient about 250 kilometres away in Nakhon Ratchasima.</p>

data.title: Committee to review cases for amnesty
data.description: <p>A special committee will review all political cases from 2005&ndash;2025 under the newly enacted Peaceful Society Promotion Act, Prime Minister's Office Minister Paradorn Prissananantakul said.</p>

data.title: KPI chief faces probe over alleged admissions scam
data.description: <p>House Speaker Sophon Zarum has ordered a fact-finding investigation into allegations that King Prajadhipok's Institute (KPI) secretary-general Issara Sereewatthanawut solicited benefits in exchange for admission to an executive programme.</p>

data.title: Business nominee crackdown widens
data.description: <p>Authorities are widening their crackdown on foreign nominee businesses and "grey capital", going beyond raids and asset seizures to trace ownership structures, financial flows and Thai shareholders.</p>

data.title: FM Sihasak kicks off Africa trip
data.description: <p>Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow begins his first official visit to Africa on Tuesday as Thailand seeks to deepen its ties with Nigeria, Ethiopia and the wider continent.</p>

data.title: Navy to extend border fence
data.description: <p>The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) will extend a border fence along the Thai-Cambodian frontier in Chanthaburi by more than 8km as authorities step up security measures along the disputed border.</p>

data.title: NIA cites 3 factors for attacks
data.description: <p>The National Intelligence Agency (NIA) has identified three possible factors behind a series of attacks at more than 50 locations in the deep South late last week, saying they could be linked to preparations for renewed peace talks and an upcoming military rotation.</p>

data.title: Judges query jail sentences
data.description: <p>The Judicial Administration Commission (JAC) has called for a review of criminal sentence enforcement amid concern that serious offenders are receiving large sentence reductions and reoffending after release.</p>

data.title: Four Thai kidnappers arrested while taking Chinese woman to Myanmar border
data.description: KAMPHAENG PHET: Police arrested four Thai men for allegedly kidnapping a Chinese woman from a hotel in Bangkok and taking her to Mae Sot district of Tak bordering Myanmar.

data.title: M82 to Ban Phaeo to open on Friday
data.description: <p>The 16.4-kilometre Ekachai-Ban Phaeo section of the M82 elevated motorway will open for free 24-hour trial use from 10am on Friday, extending the route in operation from Bang Khun Thian to about 25km.</p>

data.title: Thai passport slips in power ranking
data.description: <p>The Thai passport has slipped eight places to 99th in the world, according to a new report by passportreports.com, down from 91st last year.</p>

data.title: British PM Burnham hits a chord on Kyiv visit
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Monday strummed on a guitar and also went to a shopping mall destroyed by a Russian strike as he visited Kyiv to show his country's support for Ukraine.

data.title: Saudi Arabia to invest $7 bn in theme parks near Paris: French presidency
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France and Saudi Arabia on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding for a six-billion-euro ($7 billion) Saudi investment to create three theme parks near Paris, including one likely to be manga-themed, the office of the French president said.

data.title: Trump claims Iran 'collapsing' as US threatens 'economic D-Day'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Monday that Iran was "collapsing" as Washington prepared to announce the details of a new economic pressure campaign that Tehran has derided as an admission of defeat.

data.title: Despair and anger in Conakry after deadly landfill collapse
data.description: CONAKRY - Abou Hamza, an outraged resident of the Dar es Salam neighbourhood of Conakry where a landfill collapse killed 30 people over the weekend, said that locals had tried to warn Guinea's authorities about the danger.

data.title: OSCE says Kazakh elections lacked choice
data.description: ALMATY (KAZAKHSTAN) - Kazakhstan's parliamentary elections were marred by a lack of "political choice", according to the Organisation for Security and Co-operation (OCSE) on Monday, after the ruling party won in a landslide.

data.title: Kremlin says UK preventing peace by giving missile info to Ukraine
data.description: MOSCOW - The Kremlin said Monday that the Britain was preventing peace in Ukraine by giving Kyiv information needed to produce SCALP long-range missiles, and threatened to destroy plants manufacturing them.

data.title: TAT defines The Year of Transformation as Thailand’s 2027 tourism direction
data.description: Bangkok, Aug 24, 2026 – The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) has unveiled “The Year of Transformation” as Thailand’s strategic tourism direction for 2027, built around four strategic moves supporting “The Winning Goal 2027”. TAT targets tourism revenue growth of at least 5% over 2026, a 60:40 visitor distribution between major and emerging destinations, and a place among Asia’s top three destinations for traveller loyalty, working towards the goal of becoming “Asia’s No.1 High-Value & Meaningful Destination”.

data.title: Attacks on Red Cross in DR Congo making Ebola fight 'harder'
data.description: GENEVA - The Red Cross voiced alarm on Monday after six workers taking part in a desperate bid to contain a deadly Ebola outbreak were injured in attacks last week in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

data.title: Rare B10 coin sells for B2.5m in first online auction
data.description: Thailand's first electronic rare coin auction on Monday featured a 10-baht circulation coin from 1990 that went under the hammer for 2.5 million baht.

data.title: Honda ADAS chief’s hairstyle steals the spotlight in technology video
data.description: A Honda R&D promotional video showcasing the company’s latest driver-monitoring technology has attracted unexpected attention online, with viewers focusing as much on the hairstyle of chief engineer Shotaro Odate as on the advanced system being demonstrated.

data.title: New taste tinglers for your palate
data.description: Bangkok is a city that never sleeps, at least in the food and beverage department. Blink and you’ll miss another new restaurant opening, a drink launch, or a new nightclub. Guru By Bangkok Post is making sure that even if you blink, you don’t miss out on the new taste tinglers that are worth mentioning in Bangkok and beyond.

data.title: Thailand Focus 2026 spotlights Thailand’s potential to attract global investors
data.description: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is well-preparedto host “Thailand Focus 2026: Reignite Thailand”,withthehighlightonthe attractiveness of investment in Thailand.Deputy Prime MinisterandMinister of FinanceEknitiNitithanprapaswill preside over the opening ceremony, joined by Minister of EnergyAkanatPromphan.Top executivesfrom thebusinesssectorandcapital market& money market, andsenior executivesoflisted companies willpresent andprovide information on investment opportunities and growth of Thai businesses,withstrategicsynergytoreinforceconfidence among institutional investorsworldwide. The event will takeplacefromAug 26-28, at the Grand HyattErawanHotel, Bangkok.

data.title: Police armed attack drill sends temple monks fleeing
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Monks and novices fled from a temple in terror and hundreds of children were hurredly evacuated from a kindergarten as police staged an unannounced emergency response drill simulating an armed intruder on Monday.

data.title: Malaysia says Indonesia to open airspace for cloud seeding to tackle haze
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR — Indonesia has given Malaysian agencies ⁠official permission ⁠to enter its ⁠airspace to conduct cloud seeding operations, Malaysia ’s environment minister has said, part of both countries’ efforts to combat the haze blanketing the region.

data.title: Popular waterfall closed by rain
data.description: KANCHANABURI - Kroengkrawia waterfall in Khao Laem National Park has been closed to visitors because of the danger posed by the fast flowing river after persistent rain.
